'''Northern Mustafarians''' were one of the two species of [[Mustafarian]].<ref name="Absolutely Everything You Need to Know" />

==Description==
Northern Mustafarians were tall (measuring 2.3 [[meter]]s), slender arthropods genetically similar to southern Mustafarians but more vulnerable to damage. They were bipedal, humanoid, with long snouts resembling<ref name="Absolutely Everything You Need to Know" /> those of the [[Kubaz]].<ref name="SpecMod" /><ref name="Ultimate Star Wars">''[[Ultimate Star Wars]]''</ref> Northern Mustafarians were not as stocky and strong as Southern Mustafarians.<ref name="Character Encylopedia" /> They had keen, faceted eyes that help detect flaws in ore and machinery. Their tough exoskeletons and leathery [[blaster]]-resistant skin allowed them to naturally withstand extreme heat, but were not as resistant to temperatures as their Southern counterparts.<ref name="Character Encylopedia" /><ref name="SpecMod" /> Northern Mustafarians typically wore armor and protective gear when outside their underground shelters or while working around the lava of their [[Volcano|volcanic]] habitat. Though capable of surviving briefly without such gear, they rarely put this resilience to the test.<ref name="VE" /><ref name="SpecMod">''[[Special Modifications]]''</ref><ref name="VE" /> 

==Behavior==
Northern Mustafarians often served as guards and expert [[lava flea|Lava flea]] riders, using these creatures for fast surface travel. Many worked alongside southern Mustafarians in mining, cooperating to harvest scarce resources. Generally non-aggressive and insular, they focused on survival and technological advancement with little interest in off-worlders. They modified imported technology to withstand Mustafar's harsh environment and prefer kinetic or concussive weapons, which are heavier and more durable than typical energy weapons. Sentinels and workers used specialized gear, and many adopt cybernetic enhancements to aid tasks or replace lost limbs, limited mainly by cost. Politically, they organized by cavern-based communities, live mostly separated by region, and tolerate outside interference if it aided their survival.<ref name="SpecMod" />

==History==
The Northern Mustafarians were one of the two [[subspecies]] of [[Mustafarian]]s which evolved separately in underground caves.<ref name="Character Encylopedia">''[[Star Wars Character Encyclopedia: Updated and Expanded]]''</ref> Centuries before the [[Clone Wars]], northern Mustafarians made deals with the [[Techno Union]] to mine lava streams in exchange for [[mining droid]]s and heavy-duty [[speeder]]s.<ref name="SpecMod" /><ref name="Character Encylopedia" /> During the Clone Wars, Mustafar was a manufacturing site for [[Separatist Droid Army|Separatist droid armies]] and a fortified retreat, though fighting largely bypassed the planet. The Mustafarians joined the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatists]] mainly to secure contracts and remained mostly unaffected after the war. Under the [[Galactic Empire]], Imperial forces kept a significant presence above Mustafar. Few Mustafarians knew the true purpose of this, and most avoided questioning Imperial actions or the fate of [[Force-sensitive|Force sensitives]] sent there.<ref name="SpecMod" /> An exception to this was [[Battle of Fortress Vader|The Battle of Fortress Vader]], when an [[Kkkt's clan|army of Mustafarians]] including Northern Mustafarians, led by the Southern Mustafarian [[Kkkt|Father Kkkt]] rose up to save what was left of their [[Mustafar|homeworld]] after [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] caused the planet to scream as he built his castle, [[Fortress Vader]]. During the battle, Vader proved a challenge to the [[Mustafarian]]s, but Kkkt and the other chiefs used the Force to flood the battlefield with lava.<ref name="Vader 23">[[Darth Vader (2017) 23|''Darth Vader'' (2017) 23]]</ref>
